meta.title: Ingestion Pipeline — Corpus to Hybrid Index
meta.subtitle: How documents become searchable points, and what the agent finally consumes

cards.title: What the corpus contains
items: 611 generated markdown documents across 13 technical domains: databases, DSA, RAG, agentic AI, machine learning, deep learning, MLOps, Kubernetes, Python APIs, frontend and backend
57 reference PDFs and 30 Python API documents make the corpus realistic rather than uniformly on-topic
674 distinct source documents and 1174 indexed points in the live rag-v1 collection

cards.title: Why both vectors are written
items: Every point carries a 768-d dense vector and a BM25 sparse vector in the same upsert, so one query can score both ways
Dense vectors catch paraphrase and intent; BM25 catches exact identifiers, acronyms and error strings
Retrieval fuses the two rankings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion before the cross-encoder reranks

cards.title: Operational behaviour
items: Run per folder: python -m app.Ingestion.processor <dir> <source_type>; each chunk's metadata is also written to processed_data/<domain>/ as JSON
Ingestion is not idempotent — re-running a folder without --wipe duplicates its chunks, so a wipe rebuilds cleanly
A preflight loads the BM25 model first, so a broken Hugging Face environment fails loudly before touching Qdrant
